Thought process Thought process Here you go — dashes cut, tightened up:

Hiya | Senior Software Engineer | Seattle, WA (Hybrid) | Full-Time | $113k–$197k + equity

https://www.hiya.com

Hiya helps make phone calls trustworthy again. We block spam and fraud, and add verified identity to legitimate calls. Our voice tech analyzes 28+ billion calls a month across carriers like AT&T, Samsung, Rogers, and Virgin Media O2.

You'd join the team that owns the infrastructure behind our consumer apps (Hiya AI Phone, Hiya Spam Blocker) and our carrier integrations: the voice platform, mobile SDKs, and the tooling that validates calls work across carrier networks worldwide.

We're looking for builders. You'd start with breadth across the stack, from backend services (real-time call flows, VoIP) to AI pipelines (STT/TTS/LLM) to platform tooling, then grow into depth and ownership of the areas you care about most.

Strong in TypeScript or Python, comfortable with Node.js backends and basic DevOps (Docker, Terraform/Helm). Telephony (SIP/RTP/WebRTC), Kafka, or AWS is a plus.

The interview is a take-home that we build on during the on-site, so you start from your own work instead of a cold problem.

Apply: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/hiya/2de4d41b-a919-48c4-9a6c-e0d4f3...

We also have a few other open engineering roles in Seattle and Budapest: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/hiya?utm_source=va2zlpXPJx
